notes.title: Early Access 2.6 - New Languages Supported
notes.content:
Now, Pull Stay is localized in [b]Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, and Korean![/b]

[u][b]* If you speak these languages, please recommend YouTubers and streamers from your region! *[/b][/u]

[h3][Bug fixes][/h3]
- Mini-boss battle could be interrupted when you left a minimized enemy(by Washing Machine trap) in the previous stage

Thank you @Cementiet for the bug report!

- If Robo was grabbed by Araki while Robo was baking a fish with Shitirin Grill trap, Robo could get stuck

Recently, [url=https://youtu.be/TjQ_EyBaebA?si=SbcFOso2nM8cwXJC]GameGrumps[/url] played Pull Stay, and I found a few bugs including this one in the video
It was honorable and embarrassing at the same time (´・ω・｀;)
(The other couple of bugs were already fixed!)

[previewyoutube=TjQ_EyBaebA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Early Access 2.5 - Talking with Susumu
notes.content:
[New]
[list]
[*] Now you can talk with Susumu. He will share his hikikomori experiences and such.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/2b0a61d0ea7f8ed0f7f0f88bac2dc0db17773f43.gif[/img]

[*] You can collect Yen coins by flushing an enemy's dead body in the toilet room. It extends Free Time (between enemy waves) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/964d171b7bf4179235c29e21a059b61ca953641e.gif[/img]

[*] Enriched Kancho experience

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/067dc379c03ecfe2bc08397a8cc809e5fcc34dcc.gif[/img]
[/list]

Also, I changed the jump system a little bit. Now the jump height depends on the length of the period you hold the jump button. It's not a drastic difference, but now you can adjust the jump height & length.
Let me know your feedback about this change.

notes.title: Early Access 2.4 - Game Options, Cheering Susumu, and Water Pistol!
notes.content:
In this update, I added several gameplay options and new game mechanics.

[h2][b]Game Options[/b][/h2]
Now you can select the game difficulty, whether to skip tutorials, and whether to invert the Y-axis for the camera movement
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/adba6d7d01757392d78d8821a74ff26c37fc23ac.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/b92067dfa91e1ea7478f8e09360713ff10dbd320.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Cheer for Susumu[/b][/h2]
When Susumu is making a power-up item, Robo can cheer him to complete the work by pressing the Interact button
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/9dab2160147cb2376d12e7da204e3a9a6fb416f0.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Water Pistol[/b][/h2]
A new weapon was added to the "punishing Susumu" mini-game
Water Pistol can open Susumu's guard posture, which allows you more tactical decisions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/d58c75c3e7089468e12c65f2bb954a6b124f41e3.gif[/img]

...and other small improvements!

I am planning the v1.0 full release of Pull Stay in about two months, currently in the final polishing phase
If you have any feedback, suggestions, or bug reports, please feel free to share them in the Steam forum or my [url=https://discord.gg/dS4xBTg]Discord[/url]
Thank you so much for your support, everyone! (´▽｀)

tags.feature: Now you can select the game difficulty, whether to skip tutorials, and whether to invert the Y-axis for the camera movement
When Susumu is making a power-up item, Robo can cheer him to complete the work by pressing the Interact button
A new weapon was added to the "punishing Susumu" mini-game
Water Pistol can open Susumu's guard posture, which allows you more tactical decisions

notes.title: Early Access 2.1 "New Traps Added!"
notes.content:
[h2]Two Types of Traps Are Newly Added![/h2]

[h3][u]Washing Machine[/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/9e0332436fb9f6fa325ce0e36661b0a591bd3aab.gif[/img]

It attracts enemies and squeezes fluids out of their bodies.
Hop on their shrunken head and unleash "Super Jump", which allows you to step other enemies until you land on the ground!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/a340ffcbf9e7e9c45ebc21c33df1c31b61b3a6d5.gif[/img]

[h3][u]Roulette[/u][/h3]

It has multiple fun prizes you can win: 

[list]
[*] [b]Drum Can[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/99369c9dd7f34f9d695e69a81bc3e5581e3000bb.gif[/img]

It summons a bunch of oil barrels rolling to crash enemies!
These barrels hurt you as well, so make sure to escape or break them. They might have some goodies inside, like Beat 'em up classics ;)

[list]
[*] [b]Oden Stew[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/61818b143658cdb87818715196e0882a0116f932.gif[/img]

Oden is a traditional Japanese stew loved in the cold season.
When the Oden trap detects enemies climbing stairs, it dumps boiling hot nutritious ingredients onto their heads!

[list]
[*] [b]Drum Can at Upstairs[/b]
[/list]
It helps you expel enemies out of upstairs!

[list]
[*] [b]Speed Up[/b]
[/list]
It feels good (´・ω・｀;)

tags.feature: Two Types of Traps Are Newly Added!

notes.title: Early Access 2.0 has arrived!
notes.content:
Pull Stay is updated to Early Access 2.0!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New mini-boss "Doris"[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/c894194f5d7bc49a385fdd56466ce3242e5484a7.gif[/img]
  [i]Watch out for the crane machine too![/i]

[list]
[*] [b]New stage "Autumn"[/b]
[*] [b]New enemy "Pro Wrestler"[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/d6e5af3866869906f9c5df535fd6d86bc61c33ef.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New Robo move "Frankensteiner"[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/6e102a757b32561e6cc28f6f788b06f9533f4d9b.gif[/img]
  [i]When got down, you can unleash Frankensteiner and revenge enemies quickly![/i]


[h2]Debugs and improvements[/h2]

For this update, I did many playthroughs and fixed bugs as much as possible.
There were a few serious bugs. I apologize if such bugs have disrupted your game experience.
When you still encounter a bug after this update, [b]I really appreciate it if you could post a bug report on our Steam forum or Discord.[/b]

Also, please share your feedback! I'm curious to know if the game balance is fair and fun. [b]Do you think beating Pull Stay is too easy or too difficult?[/b]

Thank you so much for your support! ヽ( ´ ∇ ｀ )ノ

So it would take a bit more time but the development is going smoothly.
I appreciate your patience and feedback (´▽｀)
